Route 6[edit]

Route 6 consists of a road running between Vermilion City and Saffron City. The southern end of the Underground Path is located here, but according to a man standing nearby, is closed until some problem at the Kanto Power Plant is resolved.

Saffron City[edit]

Saffron City is a sprawling metropolis located in the heart of the region between Cerulean City, Celadon City, Lavender Town, and Vermilion City. The Silph Co. headquarters dominates the city skyline, two Pokémon Gyms stand in the northeast district, and the Magnet Train station is located in the northwest. It is the most populous city in all of Kanto.

Mr. Psychic[edit]

The southeast house belongs to a man known as Mr. Psychic. Speak to him, and after a moment of meditation, he hands out TM29 (Psychic).

Silph Co.[edit]

Silph Co. is open to the public, but a security guard explains that the elevator is not working due to some problem at the Power Plant. He feels bad that you wasted a visit, and gives out an Up-Grade, one of the company's newest products that has not yet been released, as a souvenir.

Magnet Train Station[edit]

The Magnet Train station is located in the northwest part of the city. The train uses electricity and magnets to reach incredible speeds, but is also not running at the moment because of a service interruption at the Power Plant.

Fighting Dojo[edit]

Saffron City is unique as the only city to have two Pokémon Gyms. The Fighting Dojo is located in the northeast neighborhood, next door to the Saffron Gym. The two clubs had once competed to determine which would become the city's one official Gym, and the Psychic Pokémon of Saffron Gym were victorious. A Black Belt informs visitors that the dojo's leader, the Karate King, is in a cave in Johto for training.

Calling for rematches[edit]

After a Gym Leader's phone number is obtained, he or she will only agree to a rematch if called during a certain period. He or she will then travel to the Fighting Dojo to wait for the battle, and will remain here until defeated. Each Gym Leader may be rebattled multiple times this way.

Saffron Gym[edit]

Saffron City Pokémon Gym
Leader: Sabrina
The Master of Psychic Pokémon


The Saffron Gym specializes in Psychic-type Pokémon. Psychic-type moves are super effective against Fighting- and Poison-type Pokémon, while Psychic-type Pokémon are weak to Bug-, Dark-, and Ghost-type moves.

The Gym uses a series of warp tiles to confuse and disorient any challengers. Step on the tile near the entrance to reach the southeast room. To reach the Gym Leader by using as few warps as possible, continue by stepping on the northwest, southwest, and southwest tiles in the following rooms. This leads to the center room, where the Gym Leader awaits anyone up to the challenge.

Although Sabrina has only three Pokémon, they can become difficult to defeat if given the chance. She leads with her Espeon; both Psychic and Shadow Ball may lower the target's Special Defense, letting it deal even more damage with subsequent attacks. Calm Mind boosts its Special Attack and Special Defense, further increasing its damage output. Mr. Mime's Mimic copies the target's most recent move, and Skill Swap lets it trade Abilities with the target. As Filter reduces damage sustained from super effective moves, using Skill Swap may actually backfire as it loses this protection. Her Alakazam cannot boost its power like Espeon can, but its high Special Attack makes it unnecessary. Both Psychic and Energy Ball may lower the target's Special Defense, and Reflect temporarily raises the team's physical Defense, a common weakness of Psychic Pokémon.
